# Nobody Won Alone

> A sourced, even-handed site about who defeated Nazi Germany in the Second World War in Europe (1939–1945). It argues that the victory was a coalition effort: the Soviet Union did most of the land fighting, Britain and the Commonwealth held out alone in 1940–41, the United States was decisive through industry, Lend-Lease, the air war and the Western Front, and many other nations fought too. Each article states the common myths on both sides and gives a fair version with sources.

Author: Sylvain Moreau. Available in English, French, Spanish, German, Polish, Russian and Thai (language folders /fr/, /es/, /de/, /pl/, /ru/, /th/).

## Articles

- [Did the US win WW2?](https://nobodywonalone.com/did-the-us-win-ww2): The short answer, the long answer, and the numbers behind both.
- [Why did Hitler declare war on the US?](https://nobodywonalone.com/why-hitler-declared-war-on-the-us): December 11, 1941: the decision that brought America into the war in Europe.
- [June 1940: France asked America for help](https://nobodywonalone.com/june-1940-france-asked-america-for-help): Reynaud's appeals to Roosevelt, and the answer that never came.
- [Britain alone, 1940–1941](https://nobodywonalone.com/britain-alone-1940-1941): The year the British Empire was the only power fighting Hitler.
- [The Eastern Front in numbers](https://nobodywonalone.com/eastern-front-in-numbers): Moscow, Stalingrad, Kursk, Berlin: where Germany lost its army.
- [Bagration vs D-Day](https://nobodywonalone.com/operation-bagration-vs-d-day): The Soviet offensive of summer 1944 that dwarfed Normandy.
- [D-Day: which countries took part?](https://nobodywonalone.com/d-day-countries): Beaches, troops, ships and losses, nation by nation.
- [Did Lend-Lease win the war?](https://nobodywonalone.com/did-lend-lease-win-the-war): Trucks, fuel and food: what American aid really did for the Allies.
- [The forgotten Allies](https://nobodywonalone.com/forgotten-allies-ww2): Poland, France, India, Canada, Yugoslavia and the others.
- [1939–1941: Stalin's pact with Hitler](https://nobodywonalone.com/stalin-hitler-pact-1939-1941): The part of the Soviet story Moscow leaves out.

## Reference pages

- [Timeline 1939–1945](https://nobodywonalone.com/timeline): the major events of the war in Europe, in order
- [Myths, both ways](https://nobodywonalone.com/myths): common exaggerations, American and Soviet, checked against the sources
- [Quiz](https://nobodywonalone.com/quiz): test what you know
- [About and sources](https://nobodywonalone.com/about): who writes the site, method and contact
